title: Project Title
summary: One or two sentences. This is what shows on the project card.
role: Your role on this project (e.g. Solo full-stack engineer)
problem: What was the challenge or need going in? (Short case study: use problem/approach/results. Long-form write-up: use `sections` below instead, and omit problem/approach/results entirely.)
approach: What did you actually build or do?
results: What changed because of it? Include numbers if you have them.

sections.heading: Section heading
sections.body: One or more paragraphs of prose for this section. Separate paragraphs with a blank line between them to render as distinct paragraphs. Two lightweight markdown-lite conventions are also supported within a blank-line-separated block: a block where every line starts with '- ' renders as a real bulleted list (** around a lead-in term inside a list line renders as bold); a block that is a single paragraph fully wrapped in **double asterisks** renders as a bold, standalone, visually emphasized line instead of a plain paragraph (use sparingly, for pull-quote-style statements).
